summary: Add a bounded exact-token layout view for selector v5 evidence while preserving the original source context and v3/v4 replay.
decision_refs: The fixed Flash/Pro benchmark showed D1 could misassociate a left-column finish with substrate code 1 and C2 could not join printed L1/L2 subtotals already present in evidence.
The saved text_map already contains the native word coordinates needed to reconstruct rows and large horizontal gaps locally.
Ponytail constraint: reuse parser coordinates and the existing QA V3 evidence object instead of adding table extraction, a semantic graph or another model call.
Historical verification note: targeted selector and QA V3 evidence-loop tests
Historical verification note: real frozen D1/C2 layout marker checks and fixed-15 page/source-atom no-regression gate with zero provider calls
Historical verification note: bundle manifest check
approval_evidence: The user asked the planned CIRP development, testing and iteration to continue.
known_limitations: The layout view represents rows and large horizontal gaps only; it does not infer table headers, spanning cells or engineering meaning.
Only selector v5 text-layer evidence with valid saved offsets and bounding boxes receives layout_lines.
This zero-call input repair does not prove that Flash or Pro will answer D1 or C2 correctly; a new frozen evaluation remains a separate paid gate.
